note: Animation frames: masked img2img (inpainting) over the chosen sprites (art/raw/dog/<base>.png). Only the ellipse `mask` [cx, cy, rx, ry] in 1024 px is repainted, so the rest of the dog stays pixel-identical and frames can be swapped without flicker. Keep masks tight (eyes, one ear): repainting the whole head changes the dog's face and age between frames. Frames without a mask are repainted whole.
